name: Knee-to-Chest Stretch
description: Stretches the lower back lying down: draw one knee in toward your chest while the other leg stays relaxed.

source.title: Mayo Clinic: A guide to basic stretches

setup: Lie on your back on a firm surface, heels flat on the floor.
cues: Skip it if you have osteoporosis.
Pull gently until you feel the lower back stretch.
Bring the knee as close as is comfortable.
Keep the other leg relaxed, bent or straight.

prescription.note: Skip this stretch if you have osteoporosis: it can raise the risk of compression fractures in the spine. Hold about 30 seconds and repeat 2 to 4 times on each side. Warm up for 5 to 10 minutes first, move slowly, don't bounce, and back off if it hurts.

keyframes.name: Lie on your back
keyframes.cue: Legs out, heels on the floor.

keyframes.name: Knee to chest
keyframes.cue: Hold your left knee and draw it toward your chest.
